cover_letter_text:
Hello,

I am applying for the Civil Engineering Draftsperson role at All Seasons Communications, advertised on SEEK. Your advert asks the draftsperson to check drawings for accuracy, consistency and completeness, and to seek clarification on discrepancies before issue.

I completed the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026. In it I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. One is a typical road cross section with shoulders, kerbs and drainage, drawn in AutoCAD. In the same course I lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services and site constraints. On site in the Philippines in 2019, on a community hall renovation, I reviewed structural and architectural drawings, checked work against project requirements to cut down on errors and rework, and escalated issues that needed clarification.

I am based in Melton VIC. I will relocate to Perth for this role and can start two weeks after an offer. Full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), no sponsorship needed. I hold a full Victorian driver's licence and a White Card. Could we arrange a time to talk?

Marc Masarate

questions.question: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
questions.answer: Subclass 485 Temporary Graduate visa with full working rights until December 2027. No sponsorship needed.

questions.question: How many years' experience do you have as a civil drafter?
questions.answer: No paid drafting role. Prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D in the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design (February 2024 to February 2026).
